source_text: 65 DE PACE SU. <B>DOLA Dispositum tempus uenit nostris pacem in urbe Et ruinas simul blandiente saeculo primis. Praecipitis populo, quem <ipsi> in schisma misistis: Aut facite legem ciuitatis aut exite de illa. Conspicitis stipulam cohaerentem in oculis nostris, Et uestris in oculis non uultis cernere trabem. Subdola pax uobis uenit, persecutio flagrat. Uulnera non parent, et sic sine caede ruistis, ********** De <omnibus> uobis uix unus caute se gessit. O malo nutriri in occisione praedicti! Laudatis pacem subdolam et uobis iniquam. Alterius facti milites, non Christi, peristis.
pass_a_gloss: Pax in urbe + ruinae. Schisma you made. Festucam vs trabem. Subdola pax = persecutio. Laudatis pacem subdolam — milites alterius, non Christi, peristis.
pass_b_english: The arranged time comes — peace for ours in the city — and ruins at once while the age flatters the first. You order the people whom you yourselves cast into schism: either keep the city’s law or leave it. You see the speck sticking in our eyes and will not discern the beam in yours. A deceitful peace comes to you; persecution burns. Wounds do not appear, and so without slaughter you have fallen. ****** Of all of you scarcely one has carried himself carefully. O to be nursed for evil in the predicted slaughter! You praise a deceitful peace, unjust to you. Made soldiers of another’s deed, not of Christ, you have perished.
